stem.text: Hex-2-ene can be made by the reaction shown.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme with curly arrows: (CH3)3CO- takes a proton from a carbon next to the C-I carbon, the C-I bond breaks and a C=C bond forms, giving hex-2-ene, (CH3)3COH and I-.

stem.text: Which statement about this reaction is correct?

A.text: $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CO}^{-}$ is behaving as a Brønsted-Lowry base.

B.text: $(\text{CH}_3)_3\text{CO}^{-}$ is behaving as an oxidising agent.

C.text: The C–I bond breaks via homolytic fission.
